scope: Corollary 6.9 (Summation of explicit particles) of the manuscript “Marked polygon correlations and one-arc bounds” (preprints/Marked-polygon-correlations-and-one-arc-bounds-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 acb3276f993c6d8e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 34-35. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
